quotes.text: I took my grandchildren there for a fun day and it was quite fantastic! It was the crew's enthusiasm and the water fights with approaching vessels that the kids went crazy over. Bring a napsack of water and snacks- it's expensive dockside.

This was a great experience from beginning to end. Our 2.5 yr old was so engaged and was one of his favorite parts of our vacation. The crew is very experienced with all ages. They even made it interesting for the parents!

We just finished our trip with Capitan Black Sparrow and his crew and had a blast. Our kids had an awesome time playing pirates and we enjoyed the whole experience. Highly recommended for families with young kids.
This was our second time. The first time our son was 4 and was completely enthralled. This time he was 6 and enjoyed it on a different level. The crew is very engaging, and the trip is action packed.
The crew was fun and enthusiastic! My 4 year old had a blast shooting the "bad guy with the water canons" Highly recommended for young kids. Will go back soon!
